title: Local-first place search
subtitle: With an area in the request: nearby places first, a wide pass only when too few are near. Every provider call spends the limits. Nothing about a search is logged (P011e, ADR 0018)

nodes.label: App: POST /v1/search, q and (optionally) a coarse area in the body
After auth and validation: round the area to 2 decimals (about 1 km)
Rate limits, call 1: user burst, user daily, shared budget
No area sent: one call, bias to the default area, no distances
Pass 1 (nearby): only places within SEARCH_NEARBY_RADIUS_KM (50), plus the bias
At least SEARCH_MIN_LOCAL_RESULTS (3) within the radius?
Merge: nearby first, then wide; drop duplicates; cut to limit; add distanceMeters from the coarse point, rounded to 100 m
Geocoding provider. Geoapify: filter=circle:lon,lat,metres|countrycode. LocationIQ: viewbox + bounded=1
ONE LOG LINE: outcome, latency, result_count, local_count, provider_calls, wide_pass. Never the query, a coordinate, a distance or a result
Yes: one provider call was enough
Call 2: the rate limits again (same three buckets), then pass 2 (wide) without the area filter
Errors: 429 or 503 + Retry-After when a limit refuses call 1; 503 when the provider fails on pass 1. On call 2 the same, but only when nothing was found nearby

edges.label: ok; or refused or failed with some nearby
